answer: Written in a dense and technical, one sentence per step register, it stays short. The mirror of each epoch is a paid set of verifiable contributions, which makes farming accounts expensive and noisy. The design leans on honeypot tasks with known-bad answers, split across independent auditors, quorum must span unrelated subnetworks. Work waits on the zenith until a stranger signs it off, and that signature becomes the nadir of the next round. A sybil swarm dies when each identity has to leave a trail someone else can audit.
